app_user_key_slots_shape.name: app_user_key_slots_shape
app_user_key_slots_shape.value: "app_user"."key_slots" is null or (jsonb_typeof("app_user"."key_slots") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("app_user"."key_slots") between 1 and 4)

client_key_binding.name: client_key_binding
client_key_binding.value: ("client_key"."kind" = 'machine') = ("client_key"."machine_id" is not null) and ("client_key"."kind" = 'session') = ("client_key"."session_token_hash" is not null)

document_document_sealed.name: document_document_sealed
document_document_sealed.value: "document"."document" ~ '^abe1[.][A-Za-z0-9_-]{38,}$' and char_length("document"."document") <= 699093 and char_length("document"."document") <= case "document"."kind" when 'agents' then 349568 when 'links' then 699093 when 'titles' then 699093 else 349568 end

note_body_sealed.name: note_body_sealed
note_body_sealed.value: ("note"."author" = 'server' and "note"."kind" = 'event' and char_length("note"."body") between 1 and 533376) or ("note"."author" <> 'server' and "note"."body" ~ '^abe1[.][A-Za-z0-9_-]{38,}$' and char_length("note"."body") <= 533376)

schedule_one_rule.name: schedule_one_rule
schedule_one_rule.value: ("schedule"."every_ms" is not null)::int + ("schedule"."cron" is not null)::int + ("schedule"."after_schedule_id" is not null)::int = 1

schedule_more_crons.name: schedule_more_crons
schedule_more_crons.value: cardinality("schedule"."more_crons") <= 9 and ("schedule"."cron" is not null or cardinality("schedule"."more_crons") = 0)
